storage: git-versioned keyed JSON datacore/rail/ep724_carloads.json — WHOLE-FILE REBUILD per run (the STB workbook republishes the full weekly history since 2017-03 every week; git history keeps vintages), NOT append-only. From 2026-11-25 the copy the server refreshes nightly lives on the volume and keeps the newest build only: a vintage is kept only when a session commits the bundled file
written_by: stb_rail.py (Python, repo root). source: STB EP724 consolidated rail service data workbook (stb.gov/reports-data/rail-service-data), discovered by link scrape (newest 'Consolidated Data through' date wins; format change = hard exit, never guessed)

attribution: Surface Transportation Board (EP 724 rail service data)

field_map.series.<RAILROAD|MEASURE|VARIABLE>: value array aligned to the axis; null where the railroad did not report (non-numeric cells become null, NEVER zero)
field_map.selection: SELECTION HONESTY, restated per record set: cat 11 Weekly Carloads By 22 Commodity Categories (all railroads x 22 commodities — the volume spine), cat 1 Average Train Speed System only, cat 3 Cars On Line all car types. Terminal dwell, grain-car metrics, Chicago gateway and the rest of EP724 are deliberately NOT archived in v1 (workbook is public and re-pullable)

confidence_model: RAW carrier-reported EP724 filings, no derived quantities. Railroad set changes over the era (KCS/CP -> CPKC merger appears as separate keys with disjoint null spans) — consumers must not treat key presence as continuity; the entity-continuity join is Everything Graph work, not this stream's.
